verification_backend.backend: binary64-nextafter with MPFR directed transcendental enclosures
verification_backend.parameter_semantics: stored binary64 parameters and grid nodes denote exact real values
verification_backend.elementary_arithmetic: IEEE 754 binary64 round-to-nearest ties-to-even, correctly rounded sqrt, gradual underflow
verification_backend.large_batch_transcendental_method: directed-MPFR node interpolation plus analytic second-derivative remainder

config.radius_selection: 4*Frobenius norm of common identity initialization; no outcome tuning
config.bounded_learner: projected Adam at every update; exact rational norm checks on stored parameters; finite-budget heuristic, not exact feasibility
config.margin_comparison: same numeric base margin 0.05 in each selected test's units; not matched raw/normalized physical slack
config.randomization: per-seed RandomState reset, common initial samples and perturbation draws for equal k; data locations can diverge

outcome_criterion.diverged: uncertified and max_k L_k > growth_factor * L_0
outcome_criterion.stalled: uncertified and not diverged within max_rounds

sensitivity.kind: short-horizon coarse-grid diagnostic; not operating-grid success rates
